calls.reason: The only independent evidence is the July 2022 Conwell–Ullman study of object relations, not object parts in October 2022. The original experiment record carries only the authors' own scoring.
OpenAI's own report shows a GSM-8K gain from GPT-3.5 to GPT-4, but the image-task improvement is scored only by the authors. No common measure compares the two kinds of gain.

The independent Conwell et al. study (Nov 2024) used unselected DALL-E 3 outputs and found matches of about 45% for relations and 12.3% for negation. That shows compositional errors stayed common, though it tests parts less directly.
No independent evaluation tests requested non-standard body-part counts. The Conwell et al. study counts whole objects, and the rabbit transcript is the authors' own and unverified.
